title: 建立 Deep Research 质量评测基线
description: 当前测试能证明接口和 UI 不崩，但不能证明研究报告可信。需要建立小型 deep research smoke eval，用真实任务量化引用支撑率、关键事实覆盖率、无来源断言数、耗时、搜索次数和读页数，作为后续优化的质量基线。
acceptance_criteria: 包含 10-20 条真实研究任务；每条任务定义期望事实点、优先来源、不应出现的错误结论和预算；能输出 citation_support_rate、coverage_score、unsupported_claim_count、elapsed_seconds、search_count、read_count 的基线报告。
close_reason: Added fixed deep research smoke task set, offline evaluator, report outputs, documentation, and regression tests

title: Restore active stream view after switching history
description: When a deep research task is running, switching to another history item clears the in-memory streaming updates. Switching back to the active task then shows the generic loading spinner instead of the live progress view. Cache stream updates per research id and restore them when returning to the active task.
acceptance_criteria: Switching away from an active research and back restores StreamingResults instead of the generic loading spinner; stream updates remain scoped to the active task id; focused frontend tests cover the regression.
close_reason: Cached stream updates by research id and restored the active progress view after history navigation

title: Make stop research halt active stream updates
description: Clicking the active stop button does not reliably stop the visible research flow and can leave failed/stopped history entries while progress continues. Add a TDD slice around the App flow so stopped researches ignore later stream events and remain stopped.
close_reason: Root cause was stale backend process, not a stop-flow code defect; closing misdiagnosed issue before adding explicit dev hot reload.

title: Fix backend.sh uv dev dependency sync
description: backend.sh fails with Extra dev is not defined because the project uses dependency-groups.dev instead of optional-dependencies extras. Update the startup sync command and verify backend.sh starts.
close_reason: Updated backend startup scripts from uv sync --extra dev to uv sync --group dev. Verified backend.sh starts and /api/health returns healthy; backend tests and basedpyright pass.

title: Fix CRA dev server webpack-dev-server override
description: frontend.sh fails because react-scripts 5 emits webpack-dev-server v4 middleware options while package overrides force webpack-dev-server v5. Restore a compatible dev-server dependency and verify the local frontend starts.
close_reason: Kept webpack-dev-server 5 for audit safety and added a CRA 5 compatibility patch for middleware/server dev-server options. Verified frontend.sh starts and serves localhost:3003.

title: 修复后端 pytest 通过后进程不退出
description:
问题：uv run python -m pytest tests -q 会打印 91 passed，但命令在 120 秒和 300 秒超时仍未正常退出。测试结果本身通过，但进程收尾挂住会让本地反馈和 CI 都不可靠。

验收：uv run python -m pytest tests -q 能在合理时间内以退出码 0 正常结束；定位并修复导致 pytest 进程无法退出的后台任务、线程、异步资源或插件问题；保留现有测试覆盖。
close_reason: 修复测试结束后 SQLAlchemy async engine 未 dispose 导致 aiosqlite worker thread 存活的问题；新增测试级清理 fixture。uv run python -m pytest tests -q 现为 91 passed 并正常退出，uv run basedpyright backend/app tests 为 0 errors。

title: 接入 basedpyright 并移除 ruff/black/mypy 工作流冲突
description:
问题：项目规则要求后端使用 basedpyright 类型检查，但当前 uv run basedpyright backend/app tests 直接失败，提示找不到 basedpyright。pyproject.toml 的 dev optional dependencies 仍声明 black/ruff/mypy，README 和 scripts/migrate-to-uv.sh 也继续推荐或执行 ruff/black/mypy，和 AGENTS.md 规则冲突。

验收：uv run basedpyright backend/app tests 可以运行；项目文档和脚本不再把 ruff/black/mypy 作为本项目质量门禁；README 中后端测试入口改为可靠的 uv run python -m pytest tests -q。
close_reason: 接入 basedpyright 依赖与 pyrightconfig，生成 baseline 锁定历史类型债；uv run basedpyright backend/app tests 现已通过；README 和迁移脚本已移除 ruff/black/mypy 门禁引用并改用 python -m pytest 测试入口。

title: 把研究计划改成用户可确认的执行契约
description: 当前 /api/research 会生成计划后直接执行，用户无法在长耗时研究前编辑计划、删除偏题维度或限制来源。需要增加先生成计划、前端确认、再执行的最小闭环。
acceptance_criteria: 新增只生成计划的 API；前端展示 plan_items、search_queries、evidence_targets；用户能删除或编辑计划项后再执行；执行接口能接收确认后的计划；保留现有直接执行路径的兼容测试。

title: 增加 claim-level 引用支撑校验
description: 当前 VerifierService 只做章节级校验，无法保证最终报告里的关键事实、数字、日期被对应引用支撑。需要抽取报告中的关键 claim，对附近引用进行 supported、partially_supported、unsupported 判定。
acceptance_criteria: 最终报告生成后能产出引用质量摘要；关键 claim 带 supported、partially_supported、unsupported 状态；unsupported_claim_count 写入 quality summary；前端能展示引用质量摘要；包含至少一个 unsupported claim 的回归测试。
close_reason: Added deterministic claim-level citation checks, quality summary payload, frontend display, and regression tests

title: 增强证据抓取管线和来源状态记录
description: 当前 evidence store 是内存层，正文提取数量固定且偏少，网页抓取对 JS/PDF/长文档失败原因不清晰。需要把来源生命周期显式化，并用预算控制读页数量，提升报告证据质量和可排查性。
acceptance_criteria: 每个来源记录 searched、selected、read、failed、cited、discarded 等状态；正文读取数量由配置预算控制而不是固定 2 个；抓取失败保留原因；报告或调试数据能看到 read_count、failed_count、cited_count；包含对应单元测试。
close_reason: Added source lifecycle status, configurable read budget, failure reasons, source summaries, and regression tests

title: 让研究任务支持可恢复的 durable checkpoint
description: 当前活跃任务保存在进程内存，resume 会删除证据后从头重跑。刷新页面、后端重启或部署重启后无法从中断点继续。需要把研究阶段、已完成 section、evidence、成本和流式事件持久化为可恢复 checkpoint。
acceptance_criteria: 后端重启后能加载未完成任务状态；resume 不删除已完成 evidence；已完成 section 不重复执行；前端能区分继续执行、已中断、已失败三种状态；覆盖后端重启后恢复的测试。

title: Polish deep research process cards
description: The research process view exposes confusing deep-step numbers such as 101/102, internal GPT Researcher wording, empty sections, and oversized cards. Improve the presentation so nested research steps are readable and user-facing without changing backend research behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Deep steps display as parent.child labels instead of 101/102; internal GPT Researcher sub-query wording is hidden or replaced; empty detail sections are omitted; long search queries render readably; tests cover the visible behavior.
close_reason: Improved process card hierarchy, hid internal wording, omitted empty sections, and added regression tests

title: Render markdown tables in research reports
description: Research reports can include Markdown tables, but the UI currently shows raw pipe table syntax. Add a focused rendering fix and tests so GFM-style tables display as actual tables instead of plain text.
acceptance_criteria: Markdown table syntax in report content renders as an HTML table; existing report rendering remains intact; frontend tests cover the regression.
close_reason: Enabled GFM markdown table rendering in reports and added regression coverage

title: Tavily SSL failure falls back without traceback noise
description: Tavily can fail with requests SSLError/MaxRetryError during normal search. Treat provider transport failures as recoverable: log a concise warning, avoid full traceback noise, and fall back to another search backend so research can continue with sources.
close_reason: Handled Tavily SSL/provider failures as recoverable warnings and added fallback search coverage

title: Remove observability stack in favor of logging
description: User requested deleting the current observability stack and using logs only. Remove Prometheus/OpenTelemetry/Grafana/Loki/Tempo plumbing, delete related scripts/config/API/docs, preserve plain backend logging, and update tests/docs accordingly.
close_reason: Removed observability stack and replaced runtime visibility with backend logging

title: 接入 Google 登录最小切片
description: 为当前 FastAPI + React 项目接入 Google OAuth 登录。先通过 TDD 做最小端到端切片：后端提供 Google 登录跳转和回调，成功后复用现有 JWT 用户模型；前端提供 Google 登录入口并接收 OAuth 返回 token。
close_reason: Completed Google OAuth login tracer bullet with backend routes, frontend entry, token recovery, tests, and env docs.

title: Make local dev scripts use explicit hot reload
description: Users can run stale backend/frontend processes and miss code changes. Make backend and frontend dev scripts explicitly enable hot reload and add tests that lock the startup commands.
close_reason: Made dev hot reload explicit in local scripts: backend scripts use uvicorn --reload-dir backend/app, frontend scripts set FAST_REFRESH and polling override envs. Verified backend.sh/frontend.sh startup plus tests, typecheck, and frontend build.

title: Adjust active research stop control
description: When research is running, remove the separate left stop button and turn the right research status button into the stop action, matching the UI screenshot feedback.
close_reason: Search form now shows a single primary stop button during active research and routes it to onStop; added component coverage for the loading state.

title: Expose deep research config from frontend start request
description: Frontend startResearchStream currently sends only query and stream, so deep research behavior depends on backend defaults and is not explicit from the product surface. Add a narrow TDD slice that makes the start request send deep research config explicitly.
close_reason: Frontend start requests now send explicit deep research config on stream and non-stream paths, covered by service tests.

title: 补最小 CI 闸门
description:
问题：仓库当前没有 .github/workflows/，后端测试挂住、basedpyright 缺失、前后端安全扫描失败等质量问题都不会被自动拦截。

验收：新增最小 CI workflow，至少运行后端测试、basedpyright、前端 npm test -- --watchAll=false、前端 npm run build；命令与本地 README 保持一致；CI 不引入 ruff/black/mypy 作为质量门禁。
close_reason: 新增 .github/workflows/ci.yml，分 backend/frontend 两个 job 运行后端 pytest、basedpyright、前端测试和前端构建；本地同款命令均已通过，且未引入 ruff/black/mypy 门禁。

title: 修复前后端依赖安全漏洞
description:
问题：安全扫描不合格。frontend 下 npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate 报 53 vulnerabilities，包含 1 critical 和 26 high；根目录 pip-audit --path .venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages 报 48 known vulnerabilities in 17 packages，涉及 aiohttp、langchain、langchain-core、starlette、requests、urllib3、python-multipart 等。

验收：升级前端和后端依赖，优先消除 critical/high 漏洞；记录无法立即修复或需要大版本迁移的残留项；npm run build、npm test -- --watchAll=false、后端测试和 basedpyright 保持通过。
close_reason: 前端 npm audit 从 53 个漏洞降到 0；后端 pip-audit 从 48 个漏洞降到 0。升级 FastAPI/Starlette、LangChain 系列、requests/urllib3/python-multipart 等后端包；前端通过 npm audit fix、升级 react-syntax-highlighter、postcss，并用 overrides 修复 react-scripts 旧依赖链。验证：npm audit 0 vulnerabilities、pip-audit No known vulnerabilities、pytest 91 passed、basedpyright 0 errors、frontend test/build 均通过。

title: 拆分前端研究运行状态和历史状态
description: App.js 同时管理流式请求、历史切换、错误、恢复、移动端和结果 hydration，HistoryContext 又混合 backend history 与 localStorage。状态耦合已经导致过切换历史时的 UI 回归，需要拆出更清晰的运行状态边界。
acceptance_criteria: 提取研究运行状态 hook 或 reducer；HistoryContext 只负责历史列表和选择；活跃流式任务、历史详情加载、错误状态有独立测试；现有切换历史、停止、恢复、完成报告行为保持不变。

title: 统一用户数据和研究任务持久化边界
description: 当前用户数据走 SQLAlchemy async DB，研究任务走单独同步 sqlite repository。两套持久化并存会增加迁移、备份、并发和部署复杂度。需要明确统一边界，至少先收口连接、事务和迁移策略。
acceptance_criteria: 形成并实现一个统一持久化方案；研究任务、evidence 和用户归属在同一迁移体系下可管理；保留现有 API 行为；覆盖用户历史、匿名历史 claim、任务详情读取的回归测试。

title: Commit AGENTS guidance update
description: Commit the current AGENTS.md guidance change requested by the user and push it to the remote repository.
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md change is committed and pushed; repository branch is up to date with origin.
close_reason: Committed AGENTS guidance update

title: Expose log extras as key-value text
description: Current Python logging stores useful context in LogRecord extras, but the default formatter does not render those fields in terminal logs. Add a human-readable key=value formatter and focused tests so HTTP and research logs expose searchable context without switching to JSON by default.
acceptance_criteria: Logs keep the existing readable prefix; selected LogRecord extra fields render as key=value pairs; tests cover extra rendering and existing HTTP log behavior remains intact.
close_reason: Completed key-value log formatter, docs, and tests

title: 修复 Google 登录按钮仍短于主按钮
description: Google 登录按钮虽然设置了 72% 宽度，但其父容器是 92%，导致实际宽度仍短于主登录按钮。调整结构，让按钮与主登录按钮使用同一外层宽度基准。
close_reason: Moved Google login button out of the 92% divider container so it matches the primary login button width; AuthPage test passes.

title: 对齐 Google 登录按钮宽度
description: 登录弹窗中 Google 登录按钮比主登录按钮更宽。将 Google 登录按钮宽度调整为与主登录按钮一致，并保持居中。
close_reason: Aligned Google login button width with primary login button and verified AuthPage test.

title: 调研顶尖深度研究智能体差距
description: 对比公开商业产品、开源深度研究框架和评测基准，结合本仓库现有实现，产出一份可执行的差距分析报告。
close_reason: 已完成顶尖深度研究智能体对标与差距报告

title: Improve deep research streaming progress UI
description: Add frontend rendering for deep_research_decision events, recursive depth and parent context, follow-up queries, cost_update events, and smoother phase transitions in StreamingResults with focused tests.
close_reason: Completed deep research progress UI slice with tests

title: 清理项目规则违例：函数注释、嵌套深度和生产 API fallback
description:
问题：项目规则要求每个模块和函数有简短注释、代码嵌套不超过 3 层。AST 粗扫发现后端多个核心 class/function 缺少 docstring，backend/app/core/orchestrator.py、backend/app/research/agent.py、backend/app/services/deepseek_service.py 存在超过 3 层嵌套。另一个部署风险是 frontend/src/services/api.js 在非 localhost、非 railway 且未配置 REACT_APP_API_URL 时 fallback 到 http://localhost:8003，生产环境会静默请求用户本机。

验收：为核心后端模块和函数补齐简短说明；拆平已发现的超过 3 层嵌套路径；修正生产 API base URL fallback，避免生产默认指向 localhost；后端测试、basedpyright、前端测试和构建保持通过。
close_reason: 已补齐目标核心模块/函数说明，拆平已发现的超过 3 层控制流嵌套，并修正前端 API base URL，避免生产环境默认请求 localhost。验证通过：pytest 91 passed、basedpyright 0 errors、frontend tests passed、frontend build passed。

title: 清理前端依赖和测试警告维护债
description: 前端测试虽然通过，但存在 ReactDOMTestUtils.act 弃用警告和 punycode 依赖警告，项目仍依赖 CRA/react-scripts 和 postinstall patch。需要先降低测试噪声并评估前端构建栈升级路径。
acceptance_criteria: CI 测试输出不再刷 React act 弃用警告；记录 punycode 警告来源和处理方案；评估 CRA 继续维护或迁移 Vite/Next 的最小路径；不改变当前用户可见功能。
close_reason: Upgraded React Testing Library to remove act deprecation noise, documented punycode dependency sources, and recorded the CRA-to-Vite migration path
